label: Ninja Woodfire
info:
Push notifications for the Ninja Woodfire integration.

The **Notify** node calls a generic HA notify service (notify contract: to, title, message, icon, channel, persistent, sticky, extraData). Replace it with your own notify node if needed.

Use the test injects below to try out each notification.

name: ① Output: your notify service (replace if needed) → Deploy
Woodfire event → notification payload
② Tests: press Inject → notification on your phone
⚙ Setup: set your HA server + notify service
info:
1) Select your Home Assistant server in each node (your own server).
2) Notify node: change 'notify.notify' to your service, e.g. notify.mobile_app_<yourphone> (progress/tag/chronometer require the companion app).
3) The function returns {title, message, data:{tag,color,group,channel,sticky,chronometer,...}}
   -> mobile_app conventions. 'clear_notification' dismisses a tagged notification.
4) Events come from the integration (ninja_woodfire_*). No entities/DSN needed.
